author: Hilary Brueck
title: Eli Lilly is set to release a once-daily pill to rival Ozempic this year. People are losing 15 to 20 pounds on it, but there's a catch.
description: Eli Lilly released new data on its oral pill, orforglipron, Thursday, showing it's almost as good as Ozempic. The pill may be available this spring.
content:
People with diabetes lost an average of nearly 20 pounds of body weight during a clinical trial of orforglipron, which is a new small molecule GLP-1 drug.colnihko/Getty Images
